comment: Corrections for Cliopatria polygons whose Wikidata column points at the wrong item, in two shapes:
1) QID-only entry: a whole lineage keyed to a narrow-era item (Kingdom of France 990-1847 carries
Q207162 = 'Bourbon Restoration in France'). Enrichment stays keyed by the tile QID but resolves
`use` instead, so the panel article matches the polity, not the mistagged item.
2) Name entry: one QID shared by two different polities (Q1068371 = Han Dynasty AND Chauhan
Dynasty). The map rewrites (qid, Name) -> `use` at click time and the sync writes a standalone
row keyed by `use` with the label/from/to below. cliopatria-polities.json keeps the KEEPER
polity (the one the QID genuinely is) for these QIDs - re-apply that if it is ever regenerated.
Found by auditing every list QID's Wikidata label/era against its Cliopatria name/span.
Known upstream breakage NOT fixable here: Q157535/Q157904 swap Zanzibar's sultanate/republic names
AND spans in the source data (labels baked into tiles), so an article swap would still mismatch.
